summary: InterPrivate Investment Partners V, Inc. (a blank-check company) filed an 8-K reporting completion of its initial public offering (IPO) on June 5, 2026. It sold 20,125,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $201.25 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share plus one-third of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. This is a routine IPO financing event, not a special situation.
